A11Y-03.resolution: Phase 1: slider value text includes the assumption, likely range, balance level, bills and income; no cover state word per day.

A11Y-05.resolution: Phase 1: contradictions removed and fewer dates on Home. A low-numeracy test is in the research kit (Phase 9).

BEH-01.resolution: Phase 1: usual spend shown beside the budget and the next large bill just after next money is kept back and named.

BEH-03.resolution: Phase 1: Room to lend keeps the reserve and leaves a budget above zero; Help says it is the same room, not extra. No repayment date yet.

BEH-04.resolution: Phase 1: one daily number per state, chart labelled as the if-usual case, What helps uses the same typical next-money date.

DATA-02.resolution: Phase 2: state downgrades for the reserve and paused income reduce some false reassurance; lumpy outflows are still a daily rate, not events.

DATA-03.resolution: Phase 2: calibrated band covers about 80 percent at every lead time up to 20 days (54 percent within 6 days before); method in README and COMPARISON.md.

DATA-04.resolution: Phase 2: no Enough under 28 days, under 14 days Not enough to tell, and usual spend never below the plain outflow average under 45 days.

DATA-05.resolution: Phase 2: band coverage improves under every shock; a first missed payout is still not caught until two usual gaps pass (COMPARISON.md).

DATA-06.resolution: Phase 2: interval window widened to the 10th to 90th percentile gaps and day 0 payments handled; next money inside the window rose from 85.8 to 90.1 percent on the 90 day slice.

DATA-08.resolution: Phase 2: a conservative share of small daily income now counts in the state. Alarm precision is not tracked in the field.

DATA-09.resolution: Phase 2: src/engine/accuracy.test.ts runs a backtest slice in npm test and CI with thresholds. Field accuracy logging needs a pilot.

INV-03.resolution: Phase 1: one rule per screen enforced by the Home view model and its tests.

JUDGE-01.resolution: Phase 1: homeView() in src/engine/view.ts drives every Home element; view.test.ts checks every persona on 60 days, balance sweeps and edge cases for consistency.

JUDGE-04.resolution: Phase 2: paused income, no-income state, payday-today rule, stale-balance handling and data age, each with unit tests; stress cases S01 to S13 are permanent tests (src/engine/stress.test.ts).

JUDGE-10.resolution: Phase 1: labelled Plan example, messages off by default, neutral icons with In this demo and Planned sections on Privacy, distinct amber Tight.

LEGAL-02.resolution: Phase 1: Safe to spend is now Daily budget with a buffer line and a not-advice line on Home; Plan, Help and legal pass follow in Phase 3.

LEGAL-03.resolution: Phase 1: messages default off. Sender identity and STOP wording in every message follow in Phase 3.

LEGAL-08.resolution: Phase 1: Enough is used only for the Enough state; Tight until for Tight.

PROD-01.resolution: Phase 2: overdraft depth is shown as its own notice. Multiple accounts follow in Phase 5; facility limits and scheduled debit orders need a bank data contract.

PROD-03.resolution: Phase 1: state-specific headline (Enough until, Tight until, Short from); daily budget follows the state; chart readout labelled If money lands as usual.

RISK-01.resolution: Phase 2: income is paused after more than two usual gaps; no next money is counted, confidence is low, room to lend is R0 and Home says Income looks paused (S09, S11, S11b).

RISK-02.resolution: Phases 1 and 2: bills due in the week after next money (less a low payment) are kept back, Enough becomes Tight if a heavy week would eat into them, and lending keeps that reserve (S13: budget R150, lend R90, was R400 and R1 090).

RISK-03.resolution: Phase 2: no income gives Not enough to tell with the plain runway as a fact; no invented next money; nothing to lend (S02, S02b).

RISK-04.resolution: Phase 1: no budget figure when Short, usual spend shown, disclaimer beside the figure on Home.

RISK-05.resolution: Phase 2: loans, refunds and listed words, large unrepeated amounts and anything marked one-off are left out of rates and income; under 45 days the person is asked instead (S04, S04b, S08, S08b).

RISK-06.resolution: Phase 2: one skipped month still counts, rising bills use the latest amount, missed bills are asked about. Weekly bill cycles and a bill editor are not built.

RISK-07.resolution: Phase 2: month-end uplift from history when two month ends show it, otherwise a heavier heavy path from the 25th (S06 now Short from 28 Oct, was Enough until 16 Nov).

RISK-08.resolution: Phase 2: calibrated minimum band, never zero width; confidence also drops for paused or irregular income and old balances; no room to lend at low confidence.

RISK-10.resolution: Phase 2: a payment due today is pending, not pushed a week; Home offers It has come in (S12).

RISK-11.resolution: Phase 1: renamed Room to lend, keeps the reserve, adds Only lend what you could manage without getting back.

RISK-12.resolution: Phase 2: small daily income counts in the headline and chart with the same shares (1, 0.5, 0.25), only with a rhythm and 28 days of history.

SEC-01.resolution: Phase 1: 12 month retention is enforced on open in LocalRepository.getRecord (src/data/retention.ts, with tests).

SEC-02.resolution: Phase 1: Privacy overview ticks removed, split into In this demo and Planned. Mode-conditional copy everywhere follows in Phase 3.

SEC-06.resolution: Phase 1: messages no longer pre-ticked. Provable server consent records follow in Phase 8.

TECH-01.resolution: Phase 2: imports are forecast as of the statement end with a notice and a balance prompt; confidence drops after 3 days and the state is hidden after 14.

TECH-11.resolution: Phase 2: today is rechecked on visibility change and every minute, so the forecast moves on after midnight.

UX-01.resolution: Phase 1: Short shows Not advised with the usual daily spend and the gap, never a figure; Room to lend explains why it is R0.

UX-02.resolution: Phase 1: chart readout no longer uses cover state words; it says If money lands as usual and Above R0, Could reach R0 or Below R0.

UX-03.resolution: Phase 1: Tight uses Tight until (hero.tightUntil) on Home, Plan, Import, Review and the Why drawer via headlineKey().

UX-04.resolution: Phase 1: one next-money date on Home (typical); the budget line and range legend no longer carry dates; the range is in the Why drawer.

UX-05.resolution: Phase 1: light Tight is amber #855700, Short is red #B42318; contrast-check now also fails if their hues are under 25 degrees apart.

UX-06.resolution: Phase 1: per BUILD2 the Plan is never empty; the what-if starts with a clearly labelled example (R200 school trip) and the loan amount starts empty with quick picks.

UX-07.resolution: Phase 1: range band has a legend for Your date, Likely range and Next money.

UX-09.resolution: Phase 1: daily messages default off at consent; Playwright checks the switch is unchecked.
